sources.title: GitHub - game2player/Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for ...
sources.snippet: Pass --thinking to a rollout to choose another. The released models have ready-to-use profiles: game2player-4b and game2player-9b. Both use the Qwen action format and allow 512 output tokens with --thinking off or 32,768 with --thinking on. See the PlayerBench instructions to run them locally or through an existing model server.
